cohort: Patients with a singleton term pregnancy who initially underwent cervical ripening (N = 5807).
finding: In women undergoing labor induction, a favorable Simplified Bishop Score after cervical ripening and before the start of oxytocin is associated with a decreased rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study examined the Simplified Bishop Score after cervical ripening in relation to cesarean delivery rates, finding that a favorable score was associated with a lower risk of cesarean delivery.
